Exhibit C ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT having an address at 310 East 70th Street, New York, NY 10021 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner") and RISINGSAM STONE STREET, a New York Limited Liability Company having an address at 420 Great Neck Road, Floral Park, NY 11001 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements located thereon,in the County of NewYork,City andState of NewYork,known as and by the street address 6 Stone Street, tax lot Block 10, Lot 32 and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements located thereon, in the County of NewYork,City and State of NewYork,known as andbythestreetaddress8/12StoneStreet(alsoknownas27/29BridgeStreet)and thetaxlot Block 10, of Lot 33 and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lot being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; WHEREAS, Developer proposes to demolish the existing improvements on Developer's Land and replace said improvements with a newbuilding,said newbuildings andimprovements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as (the“New Building"), said Developer's Land and the NewBuilding being hereinafter referred to as "Developer'sProperty"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time (the "Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained within the Zoning Resolution if Developer's Land was considered as a separate and independent "zoning lot"; WHEREAS, there exists Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant to the Owner's Land and which are not utilized by the Owner's Building or retained by the Owner, and Owner desires to make such Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as defined herein) available for use on the Developer's Property and within New Building pursuant to the Zoning Resolution;
